title: A matrix times a vector

hints: There is no n axis this time, so the lined-up value has two axes: k first, then m. Its shape is `[3 2]`.
Reshape A to `[2 3]` and `permute ... [1 0]` to put k first. Reshape v to `[3 1]` and expand it to `[3 2]`.
Multiply the two `[3 2]` values, then `reduce op=add pop=1` sums over k and leaves shape `[2]`, ready to store.

answer.code:
%Ab = buffer 6 dtype=f32 slot=0
%vb = buffer 3 dtype=f32 slot=1
%yb = buffer 2 dtype=f32 slot=2
%A  = load %Ab
%v  = load %vb
%a2 = reshape %A [2 3]
%aT = permute %a2 [1 0]
%v2 = reshape %v [3 1]
%vx = expand %v2 [3 2]
%p  = mul %aT %vx
%y  = reduce %p op=add pop=1
%s  = store %yb %y
%y1 = after %yb %s
answer.explain: It is the matmul with the n axis left out. Put k first with a permute, give v a size-1 axis where m goes and expand it, multiply, and reduce away k. The result already has rank 1, so it can be stored as it is.
